title: RT-qPCR Detection of Murine Norovirus and crAssphage from Wastewater
author: Jacquelina.Woods

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Master Mix for all sample and control reactions based on the volumes per 25 µl reaction, using a 1:1000 dilution (made in Primer TE) of FAM reference dye in the N1-N2-IC triplex assay. Do not add IC or sample RNA at this step.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Master Mix reagents in a bench top cool block (chilled at 2-8 °C) or on ice in a master mix preparation hood.
Keep enzymes chilled continually (they are in glycerol and do not need to be thawed).
Vortex reagent tubes for 00:00:03 (+/- 1 sec) at medium high to high setting.
Briefly centrifuge all reagents for 00:00:05 (+/- 2 sec) in a personal microcentrifuge.
Return all reagents to the bench top cool block (2-8 °C) or on ice.

steps.title: Prepare RNA Templates
steps.instruction: Thaw IC RNA and sample RNA in a designated area separate from where master mixes were prepared.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge IC RNA for 00:00:05 (+/- 2 sec) in a personal microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Incorporate Internal Control (IC) RNA
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of IC RNA to the Master Mix in a cold block or on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2 µL of IC RNA per reaction (adjust amount based on stock concentration to report a Ct of 20-25 in negative control reactions).
Vortex briefly and centrifuge for 00:00:05 (+/- 2 sec) in a personal microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Set Up Reactions
steps.instruction: Distribute the Master Mix and RNA templates into reaction tubes or wells, ensuring positive and negative controls are included.

substeps.instruction: Add 22 µL of Master Mix to each designated reaction tube or sample well.
Briefly centrifuge sample RNA for 00:00:05 (+/- 2 sec) in a personal microcentrifuge.
Add 3 µL of sample RNA template to each of three reaction tubes or wells.
Seal sample plate or strip tubes and briefly spin for 00:00:05 (+/- 2 sec).

steps.title: Configure Applied Biosystems 7500 Fast Instrument
steps.instruction: Set up the instrument run using the AB 7500 software (versions 2.0-2.3).

substeps.instruction: Set Experiment Properties to: '7500Fast (96 wells)', 'Quantitation Standard Curve', 'TaqMan Reagents', and 'Standard (~2 hours to complete run)'.
Identify target reporters: MNV-Cy5, crAss-JOE, and IC-TexasRed; set all quenchers to 'NFQ-MGB'.
Select FAM as the passive reference dye for the triplex assay.

steps.title: Execute Run Method
steps.instruction: Run the RT-qPCR using a 25 µL reaction volume with the following thermal profile:

substeps.instruction: Holding stage 1: 50 °C for 00:50:00
Holding stage 2: 95 °C for 00:15:00
Cycling stage (45 cycles): 95 °C for 00:00:15, 55 °C for 00:00:20, and 62 °C for 00:01:00
Enable data collection on Step 3 of the Cycling stage.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Adjust analysis settings and verify results using linear or log amplification plots.

substeps.instruction: Set all thresholds to 0.01.
Set baseline start cycle to 3 and baseline end cycle to 10.

steps.title: Validate Results
steps.instruction: Determine if the sample is valid or invalid based on control performance.

substeps.instruction: A sample is VALID if: Negative control is undetermined for MNV and crAssphage; Positive control is positive for MNV and crAssphage; and IC is positive in all sample reactions with average IC Ct values < 4 Cts greater than the negative control IC Ct.

A sample is INVALID if: Negative control is positive for MNV or crAssphage; Positive control is undetermined for MNV or crAssphage; Sample is undetermined for MNV; or IC is undetermined or average IC Ct is > 4 Cts greater than the negative control IC Ct.
